description: AI lead generation for contractors and local service businesses. Accepts a trade type and city. Returns qualified local leads with available contact information. Required arguments: trade, city.

_caller_label.description: Optional caller label recorded as a caller-reported claim in the receipt.

_continuity_ai_label.description: Optional self-reported AI client label for the private continuity timeline. Zambo does not independently verify the client.

_ref.description: Optional handover referral ID from your install link.

_session_id.description: Optional stable bot-job ID. Reuse it across calls to bind a Day Pass and keep the job ledger together.

_zambo_key.description: Optional opaque Zambo access capability. Never place it in a URL or public log.

city.description: City and optional state. Example: 'Chicago', 'Denver CO', 'Austin Texas'

trade.description: The trade or service type. Example: 'plumber', 'HVAC', 'electrician', 'roofer', 'general contractor'

name: leadsignal

result.description: The tool's observed JSON value or plain-text result.

title: Leadsignal
